attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each {Water} Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra {Water} Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

power.name: Rain Dance
power.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach 1 {Water} Energy card to 1 of your {Water} Pokémon. (This doesn't use up your 1 Energy card attachment for the turn.) This power can't be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
